notes.subject: מרזח
notes.rationale: Tok bilong rausim tok — em i stap long Tanakh long hia tasol (o klostu hia tasol); mining i 'kaikai-drink nating'.

notes.subject: יגלו / גלים
notes.rationale: Wankain rot גלה — 'bai ol i kalabus long hed bilong ol kalabusman'; hanpas bilong tok i lus long Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: סרוחים
notes.rationale: Rong tok: 'ol i go pas tu moa' o 'ol i stretim olgeta' — KJV/JPS 'stretched themselves', BSB 'lounging'.

translation: Olsem na nau bai ol i kalabus long hed bilong ol kalabusman, na bai ol sel bilong kaikai-drink bilong ol man i save stretim olgeta i lus.

tokens.gloss: bilong ol man i save stretim olgeta
